text:
sam_infra: @channel seeing degraded GPU capacity in us-west-2 since ~15:02 UTC, nodegroups flapping and OOMs on model-serving pods :warning:

maya_sre: I see it too — prometheus targets for us-west-2 show 503s and gpu-exporter metrics stopped at 15:05 :eyes:

deploy-bot: autoscaler event: group 'gpu-w2a' scaled from 20 -> 4 at 15:06 due to cloud API errors (rate-limited)

kevin_netops: Cloud provider reported internal routing flap in us-west-2 (BGP/peering). Might explain increased latency -> eviction cascade

julia_platform: Can we start a controlled shift to eu-west-1 dedicated pool? Prefer gradual canary (20% -> 50%) to avoid overload

sam_infra: Starting manual traffic shift - will push to traffic-router. Command I'm running: 
```
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/routes/shift \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from":"us-west-2","to":"eu-west-1","percent":20,"mode":"canary"}'
```

maria_eng-oncall: FYI logs from gpu nodes in us-west-2 are missing in S3; fluent-bit is throwing 403 on PutObject after the recent role rotation

maya_sre: Confirmed. Fluent-bit DS in cluster-usw2: error "403 AccessDenied PutObject" — we need to reattach the write role and restart the DS

kevin_netops: IAM role patched and rolling restart triggered: `kubectl rollout restart ds/fluent-bit -n observability-usw2`

maria_eng-oncall: Prometheus scrape jobs were accidentally pruned by config automation for the region. I restored the scrape config and reloaded Prometheus: `kubectl -n monitoring exec prometheus-0 -- kill -HUP 1`

julia_platform: Observability gap root cause looks like two simultaneous failures: region network flap + automation churned roles/configs. We should add a redundant metrics path (pushgateway fallback) and a simple heartbeat metric from gpu-exporter

sam_infra: Added temporary fallback metric: `gpu_up{region="us-west-2"}` exported from node exporter; alert rule: `gpu_up == 0 for 2m` -> page ops

maya_sre: Also enabling fallback model routing: config push to edge to prefer 'gpt-lite-quant' when host health < 0.7. This will reduce mem pressure and keep latency stable

julia_platform: Can ops add a synthetic trace/smartprobe that exercises prefix KV caching + model load path so we get traces when region flaps? Would catch startup timeouts

maria_eng-oncall: Filing follow-up ticket with action items: 1) add cross-region fluent-bit sink, 2) add pushgateway fallback for critical gpu metrics, 3) harden automation so role rotations don't remove region scrape jobs, 4) add synthetic trace and kube probe for model runners. I'll assign owners

sam_infra: Current status: traffic at ~25% shifted to eu-west-1 canary, error rates dropping. Keeping monitoring open for 30m then continue shift if stable :thumbsup:

maya_sre: Good catch everyone. Postmortem to follow once region is stable. Thanks for the quick roll and the role patch :heart:
